verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own bulk capabilities. The Bulk Write API inserts, updates, or upserts up to 25,000 records per call, with a completion callback or job-status polling. An async API pushes or retrieves large data volumes, insert accepts up to 100 records per call, and the official MCP server exposes bulk operations on multiple records to AI tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations, and detail on the MCP bulk tool's limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: This API allows you to insert, update, or upsert a maximum of 25000 records in a single API call.
When the records are processed, the system notifies you of job completion in the callback URL or you can check the job status periodically.
An asynchronous API, used to push or retrieve large amounts of data to and from Zoho CRM, through a single API call.
Perform bulk operations on multiple records at once
You can insert up to 100 records in a single API call.
